payload.text: ST0007 WP-08, devbin's side, as core owner, Utilz first (its ST0019 WP-01 is live): review each adopter's release: block against the core and fix any gap it surfaces into the next devbin release. RELEASED WHEN an adopter's release check or cut surfaces a core gap (Utilz, then Conflab, then Intent last). Each gap is a default with an override, never a per-project case, filed as an issue first; vc reviews every adoption against AC-8.1 and every core fix dc builds.
